basics.name: Uttam Gupta
basics.label: Lead Backend & Distributed Systems Engineer
basics.summary: Backend Systems Engineer with 3+ years of production experience architecting high-throughput data pipelines, multi-tenant architectures, and resilient event-driven systems. Core expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and Rust, specializing in asynchronous batch processing, database-level concurrency, and distributed transactions. Proven track record eliminating I/O bottlenecks by 95% and engineering fault-tolerant data migration infrastructure.

work.name: Zenmonk Software & Services (Subsidiary of FUNIBER)
work.position: Lead Backend Engineer / Full Stack Technical Lead
work.summary: Progressed from Full Stack Developer to Technical Lead, owning platform architecture, engineering standards, and distributed data pipelines across multiple enterprise platforms.
highlights: Standardized organization-wide Resilient Message Handling using the Transactional Outbox/Inbox pattern, preventing message drop across microservices.

Architected a fault-tolerant Python ETL pipeline migrating an entire organization's Asana history to Padmasana, using a dynamic thread pool and runtime token rotation to overcome strict API rate limits.
Engineered a two-pass recursive dependency ingestion algorithm for nested tasks, resolving parent-child hierarchies in bounded 10,000-record batches without foreign key violations.

Re-architected a blocking processing route on the Question Management Bank into an asynchronous, chunked pipeline for 10,000+ files, reducing execution latency from 5 minutes to 15 seconds (95% reduction).
Designed a multi-tenant isolation model with a multi-schema strategy on IBMS and built a dynamic, runtime-configurable RBAC engine.
Implemented a database-level Saga pattern to orchestrate long-running, multi-step survey operations reliably without external coordinator overhead.
Integrated client-side field-level encryption at the MongoDB layer to safeguard sensitive examination data independently of application code.
Authored RFCs and mentored a 5–6 person engineering team on Domain-Driven Design (DDD), CQRS, and strict schema-level bounded contexts.

projects.name: Layer-4 Load Balancer

Optimized connection pooling and raw TCP stream routing without high-level HTTP overhead.
